data.one_liner: An implicit animation library for creating smooth transitions between values in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It provides a simple widget that handles smooth implicit animations between two values over a given duration and curve. The builder function is called at each frame when the value changes, supporting a child parameter for optimization.
use_when: You need implicit animations and AnimatedContainer is not sufficient
You want to animate custom numeric values between state changes
avoid_when: You need explicit animation controllers and complex choreography
You are already using an extensive animation library that covers this
strengths: Supports optimization by separating animated parts from static children
weaknesses: Very minimal feature set compared to comprehensive animation suites

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a much more robust and feature-rich fluent API for animating Flutter widgets.
